name: tab-warden
description: Finds duplicate tabs by URL, groups every open tab by site, closes the copies, and unloads the idle ones, once a day.

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run crash && npm run bundle
scripts.package: vite build && npm run package:zip && npm run package:tar
scripts.package:tar: rm -rf .tar-tmp && mkdir -p .tar-tmp/tab-warden-0.2.0 && cp -r dist/. .tar-tmp/tab-warden-0.2.0/ && tar -czf tab-warden-0.2.0.tar.gz -C .tar-tmp tab-warden-0.2.0 && rm -rf .tar-tmp
